versions.changelog:
entropyfa 0.1.2

- Updated documentation for accuracy and clarity in SKILL.md.
- Product name revised from "entropyfa" to "entropyFA."
- Description now includes "income tax" and emphasizes deterministic calculators.
- No changes to logic or functionality; documentation only.

- Updated description to highlight rapid calculation capabilities and broadened coverage (e.g., Monte Carlo projection, goal solving).
- No workflow or behavioral changes.

Initial release of entropyfa Financial Planning skill.

- Enables deterministic financial planning calculations using the local entropyfa CLI.
- Supports reference data lookup, verified official values, and detailed provenance.
- Offers workflows for tax, retirement, estate, IRMAA, RMD, Roth conversion, pension, and projection scenarios.
- Provides guidance for both data discovery and compute commands.
- Prioritizes accuracy and source-backed data over general recollection.
